description: Change a planned article's own settings before it is written: length, tone, image style and custom instructions. Locked once writing starts.

imageStyle.description: One of the 25 image styles, or default to use your workspace's image style.

instructions.description: Applied when this article is written, on top of your workspace's article settings. Empty clears them.

length.description: auto (the article type's default), short (1,200–1,800 words), medium (2,000–2,800) or long (3,200–4,000)

tone.description: One of the six brand tones, or default to follow your brand tone.

name: update_planned_article
